description: Erection of a plant enclosure and installation of new plant at roof level.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.
Reason: To prevent the accumulation of unimplemented planning permissions and to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and to meet the requirements of Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and to meet the requirements of The Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.

Condition : 2 - Unless approved otherwise in writing by the local planning authority, the development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved drawings, documents and specifications, listed as follows: Covering Letter JS/TMB/DP3221 prepared by DP9 (dated 23 January 2026); Environmental Noise Survey and Plant Noise Assessment Report 32433/PNA1 (dated 15 July 2025); Planning, Design and Access Statement (dated December 2025); 0711_50EB_100_08 (50EB Roof Plant Enclosure Access Plan); 0711_50EB_100_06 (50EB Roof Plant Enclosure Contextual Elevation A); 0711_50EB_100_07 (50EB Roof Plant Enclosure Contextual Elevation B); 0711_50EB_100_03 (50EB Roof Plant Enclosure Contextual Plan); 0711_50EB_100_04 (50EB Roof Plant Enclosure Existing Elevation); 0711_50EB_100_11 (50EB Roof Plant Enclosure Location Plan); 0711_50EB_100_02 (50EB Roof Plant Enclosure Location Plan); 0711_50EB_100_05 (50EB Roof Plant Enclosure Proposed Elevation); 0711_50EB_100_09 (50EB Roof Plant Enclosure 1/2); and 0711_50EB_100_10 Rev A '50eb Roof Plant Enclosure 2/2).

Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development, and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme.

Condition : 3 - The building services plant hereby approved shall be installed in full accordance with the details and sound mitigation measures set out in the Environmental Noise Survey and Plant Noise Assessment Report prepared by Hann Tucker Associates (reference 32433/PNA1, dated 15 July 2025). The plant shall not be operated until enclosure has been erected and the plant has been installed in compliance with these approved details which is to be maintained as approved thereafter. 

If at any time the local planning authority determines that the building services plant is failing to comply with this condition, it shall be switched off upon written instruction from the local planning authority and shall not be used again until compliance can be demonstrated. 

Reason: To ensure that noise from the building services plant does not result in disturbance to neighbouring occupiers and to minimise the visual impact of the plant, in accordance with Policies LP1, LP2 and LP14 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023), and the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
